st01: Welcome to Lagos Island! Let's go!
st02: Third Mainland Bridge! Beautiful view. Keep it moving!
st03: Lekki toll, night shift! Stay sharp!
st04: Ikeja Market! Watch the crowd, and grab that cash!
st05: Abuja Boulevard! Smooth roads, fast courier!
st07: Desert highway! Hot road, cool courier!
st08: Rainy industrial zone! Keep your grip!
st10: Victoria Island, midnight! The city is yours!
start: Back on the road! Let's go, courier!
mission2: Another one done! You are a legend!
crash: Ah ah! Try again, you can do it!
c_courier_s: Tunde on dispatch! Let's make that money!
c_danfo_s: Bisi, Danfo! Enter, enter! We dey go!
c_danfo_g: Who has change? I have change!
c_sparks_s: Chidi, Sparks! I can fix anything. Even this signal!
c_sparks_g: No wahala, I got this one!
c_ankara_s: Amaka, Ankara! Fresh from Balogun. Make we go!
c_ankara_g: Look at those letters! Come to mama!
c_bolt_s: Lagos Bolt on the track! Catch me if you can!
c_bolt_g: Is that all you got? I am just warming up!
c_sultan_s: Salaam! Alhaji Musa is on the road. Calm and steady!
c_sultan_g: Slowly, slowly. We still get there first!
c_agbero_s: Agbero Boss in the building! Everybody make way!
c_agbero_g: Una dey try! But nobody touches me!
c_okada_s: Ayo, Okada! Hold tight, we are flying!
c_okada_g: Who needs a road? I make my own!
c_shadow_s: They never see me coming. Let's go!
c_shadow_g: Quiet, quiet. The shadows are mine!
c_scholar_s: Professor Adaeze is in session. Class, let's spell!
c_scholar_g: Knowledge is power. And cash too!
